messages:
sasha: Heads up — planning schema migration for orders.items.add_columns tonight 00:45–01:30 PT. Owners: @maria @aj. Dual-write window target 00:50–01:05 PT (15m). Will hold rollback window until 02:15 PT. Anyone objections or availability issues?

maria: I'm available for smoke. I'll run the smoke checklist and perf probes. Link to runbook: https://go/runbooks/orders-schema

aj: I'll be primary for the cutover. I'll be on-call in the office. Prep: pre-migration snapshot + disable worker queue. Rollback plan: feature-flag off + write-forward replay from snapshot. I'll post commands in thread.

liz: I'll be backup if aj needs help. Quick q: are we safe with replica lag during dual-write? Should we pause async replicas?

aj: Replica lag currently low (~200ms). Will monitor. If lag >1s we hold cutover. No planned replica pause.

maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- verify migrations applied on canary
- run 10 sample reads/writes
- check 95p latency
- run schema-compat queries

I can run these at 00:55 PT during the window.

sasha: Thanks. @deploy-bot can you confirm reservation of schema-slot 00:30-02:30 PT and post calendar invite for owners?

deploy-bot: Reservation created — slot reserved 2350001000 to 2350008200 for channel eng-platform. Invite sent to sasha, maria, aj, liz.

aj: Cutover commands (local):
```
# mark maintenance
curl -X POST https://internal/api/maintenance -d '{"service":"orders","until":"2026-03-18T02:15:00Z"}'
# run migration
bin/migrate apply --env=prod --tag=2026-03-17-orders-items-add
```
If we need rollback:
```
bin/feature-flag set orders_items_v2 false
# restore snapshot (last resort)
pg_restore --clean --host=replica ... snapshot.dump
```

maria: noted. I'll post smoke results within thread. Also will run a short load of 50 qps for 1m to verify throughput.

liz: FYI I'll own post-cutover backfill throttling. Plan: job batches of 5k rows with 30s sleep, estimated 5–8 hours. Will raise priority if any issues.

sasha: Cool. Final checklist: owners confirmed (maria smoke, aj cutover, liz backfills), dual-write 15m, rollback steps posted, deploy-bot reservation set. If no objections I'll mark go by 00:30 PT.

maria: Go for me.

aj: Go.

liz: Go from me. :thumbsup:
